eligibility.description: Applicants must apply to an eligible full-time, in-person undergraduate or master's course at Bristol and must meet or exceed the academic entry requirements in their university offer.

eligibility.title: Nationality Requirements
eligibility.description: Applicants must be classed as overseas students for fee-paying purposes. Additional course exclusions and conditions are listed in the current Think Big terms.

eligibility.title: Age Requirement
eligibility.description: Think Big does not publish a general age limit. Eligibility is based on fee status, course application and the academic conditions of the university offer.

eligibility.title: Language Requirements
eligibility.description: There is no separate Think Big language-test threshold. Applicants must satisfy the English-language requirements of their chosen University of Bristol course.

benefits.title: Tuition Fee Scholarship
benefits.description: For 2026 entry, undergraduate awards are £6,500 or £13,000 for up to four years, while postgraduate awards are £6,500, £13,000 or £26,000 for the first year. Awards are applied as tuition fee discounts.

documents.title: University of Bristol Application
documents.description: You must first submit an application for an eligible University of Bristol undergraduate or master's programme.

documents.title: Bristol Application ID
documents.description: Have your Student ID, Kaplan ID or UCAS ID ready because it is required to begin the Think Big scholarship form.

documents.title: Scholarship Question Responses
documents.description: Prepare concise responses about achievements, ambassadorial potential, your reasons for studying at Bristol and your future plans.

documents.title: Matching Personal Details
documents.description: Use personal and course details that match your Bristol study application so the scholarship system can identify your eligibility.

applicationSteps.title: Apply to Study at Bristol
applicationSteps.description: Submit an application for an eligible Bristol programme and obtain your University application ID.

applicationSteps.title: Draft Your Scholarship Answers
applicationSteps.description: Prepare your responses to the Think Big application questions before entering them into the form.

applicationSteps.title: Complete the Think Big Form
applicationSteps.description: Fill in the personal details, application questions and terms sections and submit the form before the deadline.

applicationSteps.title: Check Submission Confirmation
applicationSteps.description: Look for the confirmation email and follow University communications for the later scholarship outcome.

name: Griffith Remarkable Scholarship
deadline: Current intake deadline unavailable — check the official source
aboutHeadline: Study at Griffith University with scholarship support for international students.
about: The Griffith Remarkable Scholarship is designed for eligible international students beginning undergraduate or postgraduate coursework at Griffith University.
It recognises strong international applicants and provides financial support toward the cost of studying in Australia.

eligibility.title: Academic Background
eligibility.description: The published Remarkable Scholarship criteria require strong prior results, historically a minimum GPA equivalent to 5.5 on Griffith's 7-point scale, together with admission to an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program.

eligibility.title: Nationality Requirements
eligibility.description: Applicants must be international students and citizens of a country other than Australia or New Zealand.

eligibility.title: Age Requirement
eligibility.description: The published scholarship terms do not state a specific age limit. Applicants must meet Griffith University's course and scholarship conditions.

eligibility.title: Language Requirements
eligibility.description: Applicants must satisfy all English-language entry requirements for their chosen Griffith University undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program.

benefits.title: Tuition Fee Scholarship
benefits.description: The published Griffith Remarkable Scholarship terms cover 50% of undergraduate or postgraduate coursework tuition fees for the program duration, subject to ongoing eligibility requirements.

documents.title: Griffith Study Application
documents.description: Applicants need an application or offer for an eligible Griffith University undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programme.

documents.title: Academic Results
documents.description: Provide the academic records used by Griffith to assess admission and scholarship academic merit.

documents.title: English Language Evidence
documents.description: Submit English-language evidence if it is required for admission to the selected Griffith programme.

documents.title: Scholarship Application Information
documents.description: Provide the information and any supporting material requested by the scholarship application process for the relevant intake.

applicationSteps.title: Confirm the Scholarship Is Open
applicationSteps.description: The Remarkable Scholarship has been shown as closed for new applicants on recent Griffith information, so first confirm whether it is offered for your intended intake.

applicationSteps.title: Apply for an Eligible Griffith Programme
applicationSteps.description: If the scholarship is available, complete the admission application for an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programme.

applicationSteps.title: Follow the Published Scholarship Procedure
applicationSteps.description: Complete any scholarship application or assessment required for the current intake using Griffith's official instructions.

applicationSteps.title: Follow the Scholarship Outcome
applicationSteps.description: Check Griffith communications for the scholarship decision and any conditions that apply to maintaining the award.
